info.title: Event System API
info.description: Internal company event-management backend (NestJS · DDD/Hexagonal · CQRS). Auth: send a Google ID token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, or in dev the `x-user-id: <uuid>` header.

tags.name: events
tags.description: Event lifecycle: create, publish, open registration, reschedule, cancel

tags.name: budget
tags.description: Event budgeting: plan, record actuals, finalize, summary

tags.name: notifications
tags.description: Per-user notification preferences (opt in/out by type)

tags.name: survey
tags.description: Post-event surveys: create, open/close, submit (anonymous), aggregated results

tags.name: competition
tags.description: Sports tournaments: create, seed (elim/round-robin/group→knockout), record results, standings

correlationId.description: Correlation id for tracing, when available.

exists.description: Whether a budget exists for the event.

currency.description: Budget currency code (null if no budget).

status.description: DRAFT or FINALIZED (null if no budget).

checkedIn.description: Whether the registrant has checked in.

enabled.description: true = receive this notification; false = opt out.

userId.description: The user these preferences belong to.

preferences.description: Enabled flag per notification type. true = the user receives it, false = opted out. Every known type is always present.

plannedAmount.description: Planned amount in the budget currency.

actualAmount.description: Actual amount spent for this line item.

key.description: Stable key stored with the answer.

promptVi.example: Bạn hài lòng đến mức nào?

options.description: Required (≥2) for SINGLE_CHOICE / MULTIPLE_CHOICE; omit for RATING / TEXT.

questionId.description: Id of the question being answered.

choiceKeys.description: Selected option key(s) for choice questions.

answerCount.description: Number of responses that answered this question.

eligible.description: Number of people in the respondent scope (rate denominator).

responseRate.description: responded / eligible, 2 decimals (0 when eligible is 0).

nameJa.example: 社内バドミントン大会

advancePerGroup.description: GROUP_KNOCKOUT only: how many top competitors per group advance to the knockout.

registrationId.description: A REGISTERED registration of this event to enter.

stage.description: GROUP or KNOCKOUT for group→knockout; null otherwise.

nextMatchId.description: Elim: the match the winner advances into.

groupLabel.description: Group label, or null for a single-table format.

stage.description: GROUP or KNOCKOUT for group→knockout; null otherwise.
